title: Instead of You: The Inflection of 'helyett'

sections.content:
The postposition *helyett* (instead of) inflects identically:
- **helyettem** (instead of me)
- **helyetted** (instead of you)
- **helyette** (instead of him/her)
- **helyettünk** (instead of us)
- **helyettetek** (instead of you pl.)
- **helyettük** (instead of them)

Used heavily at work, university, and daily scheduling: *Tudsz menni a megbeszélésre helyettem?* (Can you go to the meeting instead of me?).

items.spanish: Beteg vagyok, el tudsz menni a postára helyettem?
items.english: I am ill, can you go to the post office instead of me?

items.spanish: Ma a kollégám dolgozik helyettem a recepOption.
items.english: Today my colleague is working instead of me at the reception.

items.spanish: Helyetted senki sem tudja letenni a vizsgát!
items.english: Nobody can pass the exam instead of you!
